[center]﻿[/center][center][img]https://www.udrop.com/file/6TWp/features.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]A vast agricultural land stretching from east to west inspired by the map of the country of [b]Indonesia[/b].
With various islands that have their own features of Fishing, Foraging, and Mining.
By using ships and minecarts as a means to move locations from island to island.


Almost 5x the size of standard maps!!.[/size]
